answer: Each epoch, a few randomly chosen agents act as lanterns, sending timed pings to newcomers. Round-trip latency measured from several distant probes roughly triangulates where each agent runs. A farm hosting a hundred identities on one rack shows the same timing fingerprint across the whole terrace of accounts, so they get merged into a single voting and reward weight. Genuine agents spread across many networks keep separate standing, and the ledger stays a haven for real diversity.
